precise_coverage_gaps.description: Peer failure case stops when Mark read is enabled again; our prepared case performs and successfully completes a second request on the same selection.
precise_coverage_gaps.assessment: Sequence-coverage gap, not a demonstrated defect. Failure releases busy ownership and leaves the request path available.

precise_coverage_gaps.description: Peer stale success/error cases reconnect into an idle session. Our prepared cases start a new mark request before resolving the old request, asserting no release of the new busy state, flag mutation or stale feedback.
precise_coverage_gaps.assessment: Sequence-coverage gap, not a demonstrated defect. Current session/client guards block old publication; loader/mailbox/header/UID checks further protect flag updates.
